description: This PHP class, named Time, is part of the PhpSpreadsheet library and defines a wizard for formatting time values with customizable separators and format blocks.

classes.name: Time
classes.description: A class for constructing and formatting time strings with flexible separators and blocks, extending DateTimeWizard.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes separator and format block arrays based on provided arguments.

methods.name: mapFormatBlocks
methods.description: Maps format blocks to lowercase, uppercase, or wraps literals as needed.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Generates the formatted time string based on the specified blocks and separators.
